entries.sentence_en: In the winter of 1636–37, Dutch merchants and brokers met in taverns to trade contracts for tulip bulbs still in the ground, a speculative business they called windhandel, "trading in the wind".

entries.sentence_en: Many buyers were later allowed to settle their contracts by paying a small fraction of the price, and few were ruined.

entries.sentence_en: What spread, and still circulates nearly four centuries on, was the moral: a sermon drawn from those pamphlets and retold by Mackay as history.
entries.sentence_zh: 传播开来、并在近四个世纪后依然流传的，是这个寓意：一篇取材于那些小册子的训诫，被麦凯当作历史重新讲了一遍。
entries.old_table_definition: 本文：流传；v. (circulate) （消息、传言等）流传，传播（rumours circulate）；（血液、空气等）循环，流通；传阅（circulate a report）；circulation n. 流通；发行量
